title: Genomic.Blockchain (Series 28) — Torrey Pines Mesa Campus
summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO cell on Illumina's Torrey Pines coastal-bluff campus: five zones from Charter Hall to Progress Observatory, six operating agents, genomic-sequencing theming, and steward quests grounded in the real mesa geography.

buildings.name: Charter Hall Rotunda
buildings.use: charter display, contribution model exhibits, measurable outcomes wall

buildings.name: Steward Registry Office
buildings.use: human steward sign-in and governance calendar

props: glass double doors facing the mesa lawn

buildings.name: Proposal Forum Amphitheater
buildings.use: agent-drafted proposals debated and voted by people

buildings.name: Collaborator Commons
buildings.use: expert scouting huddles and working-group meets

props: overlook bench facing the coastal canyon

court.name: Charter Court
court.style: Mediterranean plaza with Torrey pine shade and terrazzo inlay of a DNA double helix spiraling toward the Pacific
court.why_here: The mesa's genomic anchor and coastal light make a helix plaza the natural gathering point for human votes between agent-run zones.

quests.title: Read the Charter
steps: Read the charter stele and list the six reserved human powers
Log a steward entry at the Registry Desk
Trace the contribution model on the outcomes wall
Witness the human-only vote rope line at the Forum

quests.title: Evidence Round
steps: Collect the day's evidence summary from the Evidence Monitor
Review the synthesis stack with the Research Synthesis Agent
Flag one gap on the focus-pending shelf
Post findings on the Observatory metrics board

quests.title: Draft Without Enacting
steps: Request a draft from the Proposal & Grant Drafter
Amend the draft in the Debate Floor huddle
Observe the enactment threshold gate stay sealed for humans
Hand the approved draft to the Task Router for routing

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Read the illuminated task-routing board
Assign tasks to two working groups in the Huddle Rooms
Charge a delivery rover at the bay
Return outcomes to the Evidence Intake Bay

quests.title: Measure the Mission
steps: Climb the Metrics Telescope Room at sunrise
Record progress against each measurable outcome
Sound the milestone chime for one met target
Report the progress ring tally in Charter Hall
